snippet.title: Can you keep your company alive? | Heal Me Faster Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Heal Me Faster is a pixel-art incremental RPG where your combat effectiveness depends entirely on your healing timing. 

Wishlist Heal Me Faster on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5454600/Heal_Me_Faster/

Manage your camp resources while keeping your soldiers alive through intense battles. As the healer, you must juggle mana, shield marked allies, and recruit from 21 unique classes to build the perfect formation. Whether you are chopping wood or managing a shop, your camp continues to progress while you fight.

This indie game challenges you to balance town management with high-stakes combat. Every soldier you lose is gone for good, making your survival strategies essential for your company's success. With a release date set for December 1st, now is the time to prepare your squad.

Wishlist the game on Steam to follow its launch. Subscribe for gameplay updates and development news.

#HealMeFaster #IncrementalRPG #IndieGame
